scenePrompt: Create ONE finished weapon-in-environment painting for a Kalistar collectible card. Near-square portrait 1100x1250 composition. The reference is the ONLY weapon to depict. Preserve its identity and painterly materials. Build a single unified painting, not a cutout floating over a backdrop. Rich hand-painted strokes, tactile surfaces, cinematic but legible lighting. No person, no cards, frame, text, numerals, logos, UI, border, watermark.
